PC Errata 2018 disc card of [[Vehicle Mine]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 24 January 2018. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/vehiclemine.gif vehiclemine.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20180124140358/https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/vehiclemine.gif Internet Archive] (24 January 2018, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 16 March 2023: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230316094402/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/vehiclemine.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Vehicle Mine (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]].
